variant.briefing:
An emergency SOS just came through from a maintenance crew under the employ of one of Foxwell's VIP clients. If available, we urge you to get to [Location] as soon as possible. While engaging with the attackers, you'll be expected to protect the client’s  [Objects] and of their ships that may need assistance. 

This is far from the first we've seen from these particular outlaws, so believe me when I say these pilots are not to be taken lightly. I strongly recommend that you arrange a highly competent backup force to fly with you to the site.

If you manage to successfully defend the client's interests, we’re offering [ScripAmount] MG Scrip as compensation to the main contractor brave enough to take this job on. 

Stay safe, and good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
